info.title: pipwerk Studio
info.description:
Public web API of pipwerk Studio, version 1: type descriptions (with groups, methods and the indication for "Aktualisieren"), strategies and templates (indicators, trends, rules, rulesets) in the document format 2.0 (documents of the format 1.0 are accepted and converted), their usages, the consistency check, the expressions in stored form, display form, blocks and as a sentence, the keys of new objects, the use of the instances of a strategy (element of the first use, where an instance is usable, what an element uses), the instance for a template or an object type with its names, and the removal of an object with the list of its uses. The paths below /api/v1/ are versioned; the internal endpoints of pipwerk Studio under /api/ are not part of this description.

Every error answer has the fixed English text `detail`, the `code` of the cause and the `params` for the text in the language of the user. The codes:

- `object.not_found` (HTTP 404): The object does not exist.
- `object.unreadable` (HTTP 409): The object file cannot be read or does not fit the document schema. It is left unchanged.
- `object.kind_conflict` (HTTP 409): An entry of another kind has this identifier in the object directory (any entry, for example a file, a symbolic link or a directory). Nothing was written.
- `object.name_taken` (HTTP 409): The file name of the object in the object directory is taken by an entry that is no readable regular file (for example a symbolic link or a directory). Nothing was written.
- `object.builtin` (HTTP 403): A delivered template cannot be changed or deleted.
- `object.write_failed` (HTTP 500): The object file could not be written or deleted.
- `document.invalid` (HTTP 422): The document does not fit the document schema.
- `document.format_mismatch` (HTTP 422): The format of the document does not fit the kind of object.
- `document.id_mismatch` (HTTP 422): The identifier of the document differs from the identifier in the path.
- `document.too_large` (HTTP 413): The document is too large to be stored. Params: limit_bytes.
- `request.invalid` (HTTP 422): The request is invalid.
- `request.not_json` (HTTP 415): The request body must be JSON (Content-Type: application/json).
- `request.too_large` (HTTP 413): The request body is larger than the limit of 2 MiB. Params: limit_bytes.
- `request.not_found` (HTTP 404): There is no such path.
- `request.method_not_allowed` (HTTP 405): The method is not allowed for this path.
- `request.failed` (HTTP 400): The request cannot be processed.
- `host.not_allowed` (HTTP 400): The Host header of the request is not allowed.
- `expressions.pointer_invalid` (HTTP 422): The pointer of an item does not name a place of an expression in the document. Params: index.
- `expressions.blocks_invalid` (HTTP 422): The blocks of an item are no expression. Params: index, reason, details.
- `keys.scope_invalid` (HTTP 422): The pointer names no list of the document that takes a new object.
- `usage.strategy_required` (HTTP 422): The use of instances is asked for a strategy; the document is a template.
- `insert.template_invalid` (HTTP 422): The template of the request is no template (indicator, trend, rule or ruleset).
- `insert.type_unknown` (HTTP 422): The object type of the request is not registered.
- `removal.strategy_required` (HTTP 422): A removal is asked for a strategy; the document is a template.
- `removal.target_unknown` (HTTP 422): The strategy has no element, strategy parameter or rule of this kind and name.
- `object_directory.not_set` (HTTP 503): The object directory of pipwerk Studio is not set.
- `object_directory.stored_invalid` (HTTP 503): The stored pipwerk Studio object directory is invalid.
- `object_directory.unreadable` (HTTP 500): The object directory of pipwerk Studio cannot be read.
- `object_directory.not_absolute` (HTTP 422): The object directory must be an absolute path.
- `object_directory.invalid_body` (HTTP 422): The request body must be a JSON object with the fields path (text) and move (true or false).
- `object_directory.conflict` (HTTP 409): The new object directory already contains files with the same names. Nothing was moved.
- `object_directory.stored_invalid_no_move` (HTTP 409): The stored pipwerk Studio object directory is invalid, so no files can be moved. Save the object directory without moving files to repair it.
- `object_directory.target_not_creatable` (HTTP 500): The new object directory could not be created. Nothing was moved and the object directory is unchanged.
- `object_directory.move_failed` (HTTP 500): Moving the object files failed. The files were brought back and the object directory is unchanged.
- `object_directory.move_not_restored` (HTTP 500): Moving the object files failed and some files could not be brought back. The object directory is unchanged. Params: source_directory, target_directory, files.
- `language.stored_invalid` (HTTP 503): The stored pipwerk Studio language is invalid.

get.description: All type descriptions of the element register with names, descriptions, explanations and groups in German and English, with their methods (identifier, data type of the result, arguments with data type, mandatory or optional, default value, label and explanation, and label and explanation of the method) and the indication whether a use of an instance can choose "Aktualisieren" (`can_refresh`), the word for each data type in trader language in German and English (`data_types`, and `datatype_label` at each parameter, property, method and argument; for an object it is the name of the object type), the delivered templates as documents with their names and explanations in both languages, and the functions of expressions. The user interface builds the element library and the property view from this.

Lists the strategies in the object directory of pipwerk Studio with identifier, name, description, object type and the time of the last change. A file that is not readable is listed with the identifier from its file name and the mark unreadable; it is not changed.

500.description: The object file could not be written or deleted, or the directory cannot be read.

503.description: The object directory is not set or the stored setting is invalid.

post.summary: Create an object of the kind strategy
post.description: Saves the document under a new identifier; an identifier in the document is replaced. The expressions are saved in the normalized spelling. The answer names the identifier, the saved document (format 2.0) and the findings of the consistency check; findings do not prevent saving.

requestBody.description: A document of the format pipwerk.strategy, format 2.0 or 1.0 (a document of the format 1.0 is converted and saved as 2.0).

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

500.description: The object file could not be written or deleted, or the directory cannot be read.

503.description: The object directory is not set or the stored setting is invalid.

get.summary: Read an object of the kind strategy
get.description: Returns the document as saved, in the format 2.0. A file of the format 1.0 in the object directory is returned converted and stays as it is until it is saved. A file that is not readable is answered with HTTP 409 and not changed.

409.description: The file of the object is not readable, or saving found an entry under the file name that is no readable regular file of this kind (for example a symbolic link or a directory), or any entry of another kind with this identifier (for example a file, a symbolic link or a directory); it is left unchanged.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

503.description: The object directory is not set or the stored setting is invalid.

put.summary: Save an object of the kind strategy
put.description: Saves the object under the identifier of the path in the current object directory. The identifier in the path is authoritative; a different identifier in the document is answered with HTTP 422. If no file with this identifier lies in the current object directory (for example after the directory was changed without moving the files), the file is created, and the directory too if it is missing: HTTP 201. An existing file is replaced: HTTP 200. The expressions are saved in the normalized spelling. The answer names the saved document (format 2.0) and the findings of the consistency check; findings do not prevent saving. A delivered template cannot be changed (HTTP 403). The same rule holds for creating and replacing: if an entry lies under the file name of this kind that is no readable regular file (for example a file that is not readable, a symbolic link with or without target, or a directory), or if any entry of the same identifier with another kind lies in the object directory (for example a file, a symbolic link or a directory), nothing is written (HTTP 409). Links are never followed.

delete.description: Deletes the object. Instances made from a template in other objects are not changed. A delivered template cannot be deleted (HTTP 403); a file that is not readable is not deleted (HTTP 409).

409.description: The file of the object is not readable, or saving found an entry under the file name that is no readable regular file of this kind (for example a symbolic link or a directory), or any entry of another kind with this identifier (for example a file, a symbolic link or a directory); it is left unchanged.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

500.description: The object file could not be written or deleted, or the directory cannot be read.

503.description: The object directory is not set or the stored setting is invalid.

post.description: Runs the consistency check on a document of any kind (format 2.0 or 1.0) without saving it, as it is written (positions refer to the given expressions). The answer names the findings and, for each expression, the recognized names with position and identifier.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

post.summary: Show expressions in both forms, as blocks and as a sentence
post.description: For 1 to 50 places of expressions in a document (strategy or template, format 2.0 or 1.0) the answer gives the expression in the stored form and in the display form in the language of the request, the sentence, the blocks, the tokens with their kinds, the findings and the names visible at the place with their properties. An item names the place by a JSON Pointer to the document as the format 2.0 writes it (the place itself may be missing, the object it belongs to must be there) and gives exactly one of the stored form, the display form (in either language) and blocks. A pointer that names no place of an expression is answered with HTTP 422 and the code expressions.pointer_invalid. Positions of tokens and findings refer to the display form. Where an answer is cut it says so (blocks_omitted, findings_truncated, names_truncated, properties_truncated).

requestBody.description: The document, the language and the items.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

post.summary: Form the key for a new object from a name
post.description: The key under which an expression addresses a new object: formed from the name, different from the other keys of its namespace, from the identifiers of the objects of the application and from the names of the functions. The scope is a JSON Pointer to the list of the document that takes the new object (for example /parameters or /elements). The user interface does not form keys itself.

requestBody.description: The document, the scope and the name of the new object.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

post.summary: Show how the instances of a strategy are used
post.description: For a strategy (format 2.0 or 1.0) the answer gives, for each instance on the drawing area, the element of its first use and where that comes from, whether it is connected, and the elements of the flow at which it is usable (the instance is usable at an element if every way to the element leads over the element of its first use). For each element it names the instances the element uses, the kind of the use (input, expression, rule, data connection) and the properties and methods used, with the indication Aktualisieren of an input. The uses by the rules of the strategy are listed apart. A document that is a template is answered with HTTP 422 and the code usage.strategy_required. The places at which an instance is usable are listed for at most 20000 entries together; the answer says where it left a list out.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

post.summary: Make the instance for a template or an object type
post.description: Makes the complete instance (a copy, E4) of a template or of an object type for a document (strategy or template, format 2.0 or 1.0) and returns it; the document is not changed. The instance gets the requested name or the name of the template or type, made unique in the namespace of the document by a number (Name 2). Each instance and rule inside it gets the name of the instance that contains it and its former name, a number appended where that is taken; the keys are formed from the new names and the expressions inside the instance are written on them. The request gives exactly one of template (the document of an indicator, trend, rule or ruleset) and object_type.

requestBody.description: The document, the template or object type, the name.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

post.summary: Name the uses of an object and remove it
post.description: For an element, a strategy parameter or a rule of a strategy (format 2.0 or 1.0) the answer names the elements and rules of the strategy that use it, for the question before a removal. With apply true it removes the object and returns the strategy: every use in an expression that can be read becomes an empty place (an expression with a spelling error keeps the key and the check reports an unknown name), a binding of the kind strategy parameter or data connection to it becomes not set, and inputs, connections and places in sections of the removed elements go with them. The management of an element that places an order goes with it. The document is not saved. An object that does not exist is answered with HTTP 422 and the code removal.target_unknown.

200.description: The uses and, with apply, the result.

413.description: The request body or the document is too large (limit 2 MiB).

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request or the document does not fit the schema.

ArgumentModel.title: ArgumentModel
ArgumentModel.description:
An argument of a method (specification 3.1): its identifier, data type, whether it is
mandatory (``required``) and, if not, its ``default`` value (an expression that leaves an
optional argument out gets this value), the allowed values of a choice or time unit in
``choices``, the ``object_type`` of an object, and its label and explanation.
``datatype_label`` is the word for its data type in trader language. Arguments
stand in the order of this list; the mandatory ones come before the optional ones.

BindingDocument.title: BindingDocument
BindingDocument.description: Value of a parameter or property with its kind of binding.

BindingKind.title: BindingKind
BindingKind.description: How a parameter or property receives its value (glossary "Bindungsart").

BlockModel.title: BlockModel
BlockModel.description:
A block of an expression (specification 3.4). Every kind uses the fields that belong
to it: ``name`` the keys in ``path`` (for example ``["ema20", "wert"]``), ``literal`` its
``value`` and ``datatype`` (a percentage is the number as written: 5 for 5 %),
``comparison`` and ``arithmetic`` their ``operator`` (an arithmetic block with one child is
a sign), ``logic`` ``and``, ``or`` or ``not``, ``function`` the name of the function from the
list of the functions; ``children`` are the operands in the order of the expression. A
crossing of two lines is no block: it is made of "previous value of" (``PREVIOUS``),
comparisons and ``and``. A ``name`` block with ``call`` true is the result of a method: its
``path`` ends with the method (``["reihe", "wert_vor"]``) and its ``children`` are the blocks
of the arguments in the order of the method (none for a method without arguments;
``call`` is false or left out for a plain name, which has no children).

CheckResponse.title: CheckResponse
CheckResponse.description: Result of the consistency check of a document that was not saved.

ChoiceModel.title: ChoiceModel
ChoiceModel.description: A fixed value of a choice.

ChoiceValueModel.title: ChoiceValueModel
ChoiceValueModel.description: A possible value of a property that is a choice.

ConditionModel.title: ConditionModel
ConditionModel.description:
The parameter or property applies only if the parameter or property ``name`` has
``value``.

ConnectionDocument.title: ConnectionDocument
ConnectionDocument.description: A connection from an output of an element to an element.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

property.title: Property
property.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

DataLinkDocument.title: DataLinkDocument
DataLinkDocument.description:
The value of a data connection: a property of an instance on the drawing area, by the
keys of the instance and of the property.

DataType.title: DataType
DataType.description: Data types of parameters, properties and expression values.

DataTypeModel.title: DataTypeModel
DataTypeModel.description:
A data type with its word in trader language in German and English (specification 3.1,
5.4). The word for the data type ``object`` is the general one; a field of this data type
carries the name of its object type in ``datatype_label``.

anyOf.description: Name of the user, free text
Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

ElementDocument.title: ElementDocument
ElementDocument.description:
An element on the drawing area. The type is a text; an unknown type is valid and
its values are kept. An element with an instance has no name and no key of its own.

ElementKind.title: ElementKind
ElementKind.description: The kind ("Art") of a type description.

ElementTypesResponse.title: ElementTypesResponse
ElementTypesResponse.description:
All type descriptions of the element register, the words for the data types in trader
language, the delivered templates as documents with their texts in both languages, and the
functions of expressions.

ElementUsageModel.title: ElementUsageModel
ElementUsageModel.description: The instances an element uses, in the order of the flow of the strategy.

ElementUseModel.title: ElementUseModel
ElementUseModel.description:
How an element uses an instance. ``kind`` is ``input`` (an input of the element),
``expression`` (a name in an expression of the element), ``rule`` (a name in a rule of the
element or of the strategy) or ``data_link`` (a data connection: a binding of the element or
of another instance). ``by_instance`` is the key of that other instance: the use then
takes place at the element of its first use. ``members`` are the properties and methods that
are used.

ErrorPlace.title: ErrorPlace
ErrorPlace.description: One error of a request or document: the place and the error type.

ExpressionAnswer.title: ExpressionAnswer
ExpressionAnswer.description:
The answer for one item. ``stored`` and ``display`` (in the language of the request)
are the expression in both forms. ``sentence`` and ``blocks`` are ``null`` for an
expression with a syntax problem; ``blocks_omitted`` is true if the blocks were left out
because they are nested deeper than the limit. The positions of ``tokens`` and of the
findings refer to ``display``. ``findings_truncated`` is true if the expression has
more findings than are listed; ``names_truncated`` if the list of names was cut at
the limit.

ExpressionItem.description:
One place of an expression and the text to answer for. ``pointer`` is a JSON Pointer
(RFC 6901) to the place in the document as the format 2.0 writes it, for example
``/elements/3/parameters/ausdruck/value``; the place itself may be missing in the
document, the object it belongs to must be there. Exactly one of ``stored`` (stored form),
``display`` (display form in either language) and ``blocks`` is given.
ExpressionItem.title: ExpressionItem

ExpressionNamesModel.title: ExpressionNamesModel
ExpressionNamesModel.description:
The names recognized in one expression. ``element`` and ``subject`` tell where the
expression stands, ``field`` which expression it is (as for a finding).

ExpressionsRequest.description:
The request of ``/api/v1/expressions``: the document (strategy or template, format 2.0
or 1.0), the language of the answer and 1 to 50 items.
ExpressionsRequest.title: ExpressionsRequest

ExpressionsResponse.title: ExpressionsResponse
ExpressionsResponse.description: The answers in the order of the items of the request.

FindingModel.title: FindingModel
FindingModel.description:
A finding of the consistency check (specification 3.6): the identifier of the finding
with the data for the text; the library writes no text.

So that findings with the same text can be told apart, a finding names what the user sees:
``element_name`` is the name of the affected element (the name the user gave it, else the
name of its type), ``subject_name`` the name of the affected instance or rule, and
``field_label`` the label of the affected field, as the element or instance shows it. The
names of the user are the same in both languages; the labels of the types come in German
and English. Each is ``null`` where the finding has no such thing (``element`` and
``subject`` stay the identifiers, ``details.field`` the identifier of the field).

FunctionModel.title: FunctionModel
FunctionModel.description:
A function of expressions with its signature, its name in trader language and its
explanation.

FunctionParameterModel.title: FunctionParameterModel
FunctionParameterModel.description: A parameter of a function of expressions.

Group.title: Group
Group.description:
Group of the element library (specification 3.1, 5.2). The names of the groups in
German and English are not part of the type description; the user interface has them.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Version of the format; a document of a higher major version is rejected, one of the major version 1 is read by converting it

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

IndicatorDocument.title: IndicatorDocument
IndicatorDocument.description: Document of an indicator: ``Indikator`` or a delivered indicator type.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

property.title: Property
property.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

InputDocument.title: InputDocument
InputDocument.description:
An input of an element: an instance on the drawing area and either its property or its
method with the values of the arguments, and the indication "Aktualisieren".

``property`` is the key of the property or, with ``kind`` ``method``, of the method.
``kind`` is ``property`` if it is left out, ``arguments`` is empty and ``refresh`` false
(a document without these indications).

InsertRequest.description:
The request of ``/api/v1/insert``: the document the instance is for (strategy or template,
format 2.0 or 1.0) and exactly one of ``template`` (the document of a template: indicator,
trend, rule or ruleset) and ``object_type`` (the identifier of a registered object type).
``name`` is the wanted name of the instance, else the name of the template or of the type in
``language`` (``de`` if left out).
InsertRequest.title: InsertRequest

InsertResponse.title: InsertResponse
InsertResponse.description:
The new instance, complete (E4): its name is made unique in the namespace of the document;
each instance and rule inside it has the name "<name of the instance that contains it> <former
name>" (a number appended where that is taken), its own key, and the expressions inside the
instance use the new keys. ``origin`` names the object type and the template. The document
itself is not changed; the caller puts the instance where it belongs (an element, the rules of
the strategy or of an element, or the instances or rules of another instance).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

first_use.title: First Use
first_use.description: Identifier of the element with which the user first connected the instance, or null

InstanceDocument.title: InstanceDocument
InstanceDocument.description:
A complete copy of a template or object type (E4). The base classes are in this
order so that name, key, object type and origin come before the content.

InstanceUsageModel.title: InstanceUsageModel
InstanceUsageModel.description:
The use of one instance on the drawing area (specification 3.3).

``instance`` is its key and ``element`` the identifier of the element that shows it.
``first_use`` is the identifier of the element of its first use, ``null`` if no element uses
it (the check then reports ``instance.unconnected``); ``first_use_source`` tells where that
comes from: ``stored`` (the instance stores it), ``flow`` (the first element in the order of the
flow that uses it), ``instance`` (only another instance uses it: the element of that instance)
or ``rule`` (only a rule of the strategy uses it: the first element that takes rules).
``usable_everywhere`` is true if the instance is usable at every element (no first use, or no
way of the flow leads to it); otherwise ``usable_at`` lists the elements of the flow at which
it is usable. ``usable_at_omitted`` is true where the list was left out because the limit of
entries of the answer was reached. A rule of the strategy can use every instance.

InvalidRequest.title: InvalidRequest
InvalidRequest.description:
Error body for a request or document that does not fit the schema (HTTP 422). Names
at most 50 places and the error type of each, never the values.

KeyRequest.description:
The request of ``/api/v1/keys``: the document (strategy or template, format 2.0 or
1.0), the JSON Pointer to the list that takes the new object (for example ``/parameters`` or
``/elements``) and the name. ``kind`` and ``object_type`` decide the key when the name gives
none (a condition becomes ``bedingung``, an instance takes the identifier of its object
type).
KeyRequest.title: KeyRequest

KeyResponse.title: KeyResponse
KeyResponse.description:
The key for the new object: different from the other keys of its namespace, from the
identifiers of the objects of the application and from the names of the functions.

LabelModel.title: LabelModel
LabelModel.description: A text in German and English.

MemberUseModel.title: MemberUseModel
MemberUseModel.description:
A property or method of an instance that an element uses. ``name`` is its identifier (for
something inside a contained instance the identifiers joined with points); ``arguments`` are
the fixed values of the arguments of an input that names a method; ``refresh`` is the
indication "Aktualisieren" of an input.

MethodModel.title: MethodModel
MethodModel.description:
A method of a type (specification 3.1, req-fach-055): an expression addresses it as
``Object.Method(Arguments)`` with the values of the arguments separated by ``;``. ``datatype``
is the data type of the result, with ``choices`` (a result that is a choice or a time unit)
and ``object_type`` (a result that is an object) like a property; ``arguments`` are the
arguments in their order. ``datatype_label`` is the word for the data type of the result in
trader language. The delivered types have no methods.

NameModel.title: NameModel
NameModel.description:
A name recognized in an expression; ``start`` is the first character and ``end`` the
position after the last character.

NameSegmentModel.title: NameSegmentModel
NameSegmentModel.description: One part of a recognized name.

ObjectList.title: ObjectList
ObjectList.description: The objects of one kind, sorted by name; the not readable ones come last.

ObjectListEntry.title: ObjectListEntry
ObjectListEntry.description:
An object in the list. A file that is not readable (cannot be read, does not fit the
schema or names another identifier than its file name) has only the identifier, the time
of its last change and ``unreadable`` true; it is not changed.

anyOf.description: Name of the user, free text

OriginDocument.title: OriginDocument
OriginDocument.description:
Origin of an instance: object type and, if known, the identifier of the template and,
for a template of the user only, its name at the time of insertion.

OutputModel.title: OutputModel
OutputModel.description: An output of an element of the flow.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

ParameterDefinitionDocument.title: ParameterDefinitionDocument
ParameterDefinitionDocument.description: Own parameter of a template or instance.

ParameterModel.title: ParameterModel
ParameterModel.description:
A parameter of a type. ``datatype_label`` is the word for its data type in trader
language, for an object the name of its object type.

PositionDocument.title: PositionDocument
PositionDocument.description: The place of an element on the drawing area, set by the user.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

PropertyDefinitionDocument.title: PropertyDefinitionDocument
PropertyDefinitionDocument.description: Own property of an indicator or trend with its expression.

PropertyModel.title: PropertyModel
PropertyModel.description:
A property of a type. ``datatype_label`` is the word for its data type in trader
language, for an object the name of its object type.

RemovalRequest.description:
The request of ``/api/v1/removals``: the document (a strategy, format 2.0 or 1.0), what
to remove and whether to do it. ``kind`` is ``element`` (``target`` is the identifier of the
element; an element that places an order takes its management with it),
``strategy_parameter`` (``target`` is its key) or ``rule`` (``target`` is the key of a rule
of the strategy or of an element). Without ``apply`` the answer only names the uses, for
the question before the removal.
RemovalRequest.title: RemovalRequest

RemovalResponse.title: RemovalResponse
RemovalResponse.description:
Who uses the object: ``used_by`` the identifiers of the elements, in the order of the
strategy (an instance counts as the element that shows it), and ``used_by_rules`` the keys of
the rules of the strategy. With ``apply`` the object is removed: ``removed`` lists the
identifiers of the removed elements and ``document`` is the strategy after the removal, in the
format 2.0 (every use in an expression is an empty place, a binding to it is "not set", inputs,
connections and places in sections of removed elements are gone); else both are empty.

ResultKind.title: ResultKind
ResultKind.description: How the result type of a function follows.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Version of the format; a document of a higher major version is rejected, one of the major version 1 is read by converting it

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Version of the format; a document of a higher major version is rejected, one of the major version 1 is read by converting it

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

SavedIndicator.title: SavedIndicator
SavedIndicator.description: Answer to saving a document of the kind indicator: the identifier, the document as saved (expressions in the normalized spelling) and the findings of the consistency check.

SavedRule.title: SavedRule
SavedRule.description: Answer to saving a document of the kind rule: the identifier, the document as saved (expressions in the normalized spelling) and the findings of the consistency check.

SavedRuleset.title: SavedRuleset
SavedRuleset.description: Answer to saving a document of the kind ruleset: the identifier, the document as saved (expressions in the normalized spelling) and the findings of the consistency check.

SavedStrategy.title: SavedStrategy
SavedStrategy.description: Answer to saving a document of the kind strategy: the identifier, the document as saved (expressions in the normalized spelling) and the findings of the consistency check.

SavedTrend.title: SavedTrend
SavedTrend.description: Answer to saving a document of the kind trend: the identifier, the document as saved (expressions in the normalized spelling) and the findings of the consistency check.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

SectionDocument.title: SectionDocument
SectionDocument.description:
A section: a named group of elements of one flow that can be collapsed. ``flow`` is the
identifier of the element "Order aufgeben" whose management the section belongs to, or
``null`` for the main flow.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Version of the format; a document of a higher major version is rejected, one of the major version 1 is read by converting it

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

key.title: Key
key.description: Key of an object in an expression: a simple name

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

StrategyParameterDocument.title: StrategyParameterDocument
StrategyParameterDocument.description: Parameter of a strategy: a value or "at the application".

TemplateTextsModel.title: TemplateTextsModel
TemplateTextsModel.description:
The name and the explanation of a delivered template in both languages (the document
stores one name only) and its group of the element library.

TokenModel.title: TokenModel
TokenModel.description:
A part of an expression: ``start`` is the first character and ``end`` the position
after the last. For a bracket ``partner`` is the index of the bracket that belongs to it in
the list.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Version of the format; a document of a higher major version is rejected, one of the major version 1 is read by converting it

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the user, free text

TypeDescriptionModel.title: TypeDescriptionModel
TypeDescriptionModel.description:
Description of an element type or object type: the data the user interface is built
from (specification 3.1). ``group`` is the group of the element library: ``flow``,
``calculation``, ``indicators``, ``trends``, ``market``, ``account``, ``actions`` or
``rules``, ``null`` for a type that is not in it; the names of the groups in both languages
are not part of the description, the user interface has them. ``explanation`` is the short
text on pointing at the type, in the language of a trader. ``methods`` are the methods of
the type (empty for every delivered type). ``can_refresh`` tells whether a use of an
instance of this type can choose "Aktualisieren"; a template of the user and its instances
take it from their object type.

UsageEntry.title: UsageEntry
UsageEntry.description: A strategy or template that contains an instance made from the template.

UsageRequest.description: The request of ``/api/v1/usage``: the document (a strategy, format 2.0 or 1.0).
UsageRequest.title: UsageRequest

UsageResponse.title: UsageResponse
UsageResponse.description:
The use of the instances of a strategy: ``instances`` in the order of the strategy,
``elements`` the elements that use instances in the order of the flow, ``strategy_rules`` the
uses by rules of the strategy. ``truncated`` is true if the limit of entries was reached.

UsagesResponse.title: UsagesResponse
UsagesResponse.description: The usages of a template. Files that are not readable are skipped and counted.

VisibleArgumentModel.title: VisibleArgumentModel
VisibleArgumentModel.description:
An argument of a visible method: key, label, data type with its word in trader language
(``datatype_label``), whether it is mandatory (``required``), its ``default`` value if it is
optional, its explanation and the possible values of a choice.

VisibleMethodModel.title: VisibleMethodModel
VisibleMethodModel.description:
A method of a visible name (specification 3.4): an expression addresses it as
``Name.Method(Arguments)``. ``datatype`` is the data type of the result, ``datatype_label``
its word in trader language and ``choices`` its values if it is a choice;
``previous_value`` tells that ``PREVIOUS`` may stand around the result; ``arguments`` are
the arguments in their order.

VisibleNameModel.title: VisibleNameModel
VisibleNameModel.description:
A name that an expression can address at the place. ``display`` is the name in the
language of the request and ``path`` the keys. ``datatype_label`` is the word for the data
type of a strategy parameter or parameter. ``contents`` are the instances and rules
contained in an instance or ruleset. ``properties`` are the properties and ``methods`` the
methods of the name. ``properties_truncated`` is true if the list of properties or the list
of methods was cut at the limit.

VisiblePropertyModel.title: VisiblePropertyModel
VisiblePropertyModel.description:
A property of a visible name. ``datatype_label`` is the word for its data type in
trader language (for an object the name of its object type). ``previous_value`` tells that
the fachmodell defines an earlier value for it, so that ``PREVIOUS`` ("previous value of")
may stand around it (specification 3.4); the blocks offer only such values as the argument
of "previous value of".
